social media is a valuable resource for hotel revenue management and that the industry is still in the early stages of leveraging this opportunity.

social media can be used for a variety of revenue management-related purposes, including: (1) improving the accuracy of demand forecasts, (2) increasing customer loyalty, (3) increasing customer engagement and (4) improving the effectiveness of pricing and promotions.

social media can be used to: (a) identify and track trends, (b) monitor and manage customer perceptions, (c) improve customer segmentation and (d) improve the effectiveness of pricing and distribution strategies.

the opportunities, issues and unanswered questions associated with the integration of social media into hotel revenue management.
the opportunities and issues that arise as the revenue management function evolves to encompass the use of social media as a tool to enhance revenue performance.
the potential for hotel companies to leverage social media to improve their revenue management capabilities.
